integrity: The directional formula is proved analytically from the source's projection-support restriction and the planar support-function area identity. Symbolic calculations are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the canonical cubic family and assumes the displayed function is a support function; it does not determine the maximal admissible parameter interval or classify brightness profiles of all threefold-projection exceptions.
title: Exact brightness profile of the cubic threefold-projection exception
